# U181: Stages in the library and on a metric’s page: as Amara, Metrics shows each metric’s stage first as the step shape and its word, best stage first; the stage control counts All 13, Verified 3, Defined 5 and Draft 5; Draft lists the five, most goals first, each saying what it needs; To sort out says what’s needed and who; Change failure rate’s page reads Verified · Refreshed weekly · Rolling 28 days, with its numerator and denominator, its source link, its company baseline and Amara’s verification; as Pavel, changing Production deploys per day’s source takes it back to Defined, and its page names the change in an outlined box

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-STAGE`, `METRICS-LIBRARY`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/metrics` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U181

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/metrics` in the demo.
- **Check:** The metric row (`.metric-row`) shows.
- _Note:_ A computer shows the stage control above the list; a phone folds it into a Stage menu beside Filters.
- **Check:** (`entry`) it is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/All 13/.test(said) && /Verified 3/.test(said) && /Defined 5/.test(said) && /Draft 5/.test(said)`, where `const stages = p.getByRole('group', { name: 'Stage' })`; `const said = (await stages.innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: the stage control says “{said}”.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `(await mark.count()) === 1 && (await mark.locator('svg.stage-shape').count()) === 1 && (await mark.innerText()).trim() === 'Verified'`, where `const first = p.locator('.metric-row').first()`; `const mark = first.locator('.stage-mark')`. Else it says: the first row’s stage is “{mark.innerText().catch(() => '')}”, not the shape and Verified.
- **Step.** Press the “Draft” button in the “Stage” group.
- **Check:** “5 metrics, most goals first.” is shown in the count line (else: Draft does not list five metrics, most goals first).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `drafts.length === 5 && drafts.every((t) => /\bDraft\b/.test(t) && /needs /.test(t))`, where `const drafts = await p.locator('.metric-row').evaluateAll((rs) => rs.map((r) => r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')))`. Else it says: a Draft row does not say what it needs: {drafts.join(' | ')}.
- **Step.** Press the “To sort out” button in the “Stage” group.
- **Check:** “Add a link to the report or query” is shown in the metric row (`.metric-row`) (else: To sort out does not say what Flaky test rate needs).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “library”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Go to `/metrics/cfr` in the demo.
- **Check:** The “Change failure rate” heading shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/Verified/.test(top) && /Refreshed weekly/.test(top) && /Rolling 28 days/.test(top) && /lower is better/.test(top)`, where `const top = (await p.locator('.metric-top').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: the top line says “{top}”.
- **Check:** “Numerator” is shown in the “Calculation” part (`[data-part="Calculation"]`) (else: the page does not show the numerator).
- **Check:** “Denominator” is shown in the “Calculation” part (`[data-part="Calculation"]`) (else: the page does not show the denominator).
- **Check:** (`logged`) there are 1 of the a in the “Source” part (`[data-part="Source"] a[href^="http"]`) (else: the source has no link to its report).
- **Check:** “Company” is shown in the “Baselines” part (`[data-part="Baselines"]`) (else: the company baseline is not listed).
- **Check:** “Verified by Amara Nwosu” is shown in the “Verification” part (`[data-part="Verification"]`) (else: the verification record is not shown).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “metric”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Pavel changes the source of the Verified Production deploys per day (journey 5): it lapses to Defined, and says why.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `(k) => localStorage.setItem(k, 'pavel')`, given `'goals-app-viewer:platform-org'`.
- Go to `/metrics/metric_deploys/edit` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type “Deploy pipeline events” into the “Source” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Save metric” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Change it, and lapse Verified” button in the part `[data-check="lapse"]`.
- **Step.** Press the “Save metric” button.
- If a dialog is there:
  - If the “Same number, better words” field in a dialog is there:
    - Tick the “Same number, better words” field in a dialog.
  - **Step.** Press the “(Change the source / Save these changes / Save changes)” button in a dialog.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** “No longer Verified: the source changed” is shown in the “No longer Verified” part (`[data-part="No longer Verified"]`) (else: the lapse is not named on the page).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `new Set(outline).size === 1 && outline[0] !== '0px'`, where `const box = p.locator('[data-part="No longer Verified"]')`; `const outline = await box.evaluate((e) => { const c = getComputedStyle(e); return [c.borderTopWidth, c.borderRightWidth, c.borderBottomWidth, c.borderLeftWidth]; })`. Else it says: the lapse box is not a full outline ({outline.join(' ')}).
- **Check:** “Defined” is shown in the metric top (`.metric-top`) (else: the page does not read Defined after the change).
- Close this browser.
